title: finalise writes the engine's contract as compact JSON and one LF, in the engine's member order, and ends the engine.
why: behavioural spec 'finalise': when the result carries 'contract', writes it to '<contract directory>/<consumer>-<provider>.janus.json' as compact UTF-8 JSON followed by one LF (contract spec §2.4), members in the order the engine returned them; the SDK never reorders, merges or edits a contract. Then ends the engine (engine-protocol spec §6).
note: The engine's members here are deliberately not in alphabetical order, and the strings carry non-ASCII and characters a writer may escape: what is checked is that the SDK reordered, re-indented and re-escaped nothing. It is not a test of number spellings — an SDK that parses the frame can only reconstruct those (Phase 9 finding 6), and ADR 0017 compares content, not bytes.
